extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: A large-scale dataset for semantic-controlled video generation containing over 100,000 paired video samples across 100 semantic conditions in 4 categories: concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement. The dataset was created using 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet combined with Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models and community LoRAs.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu; Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance and The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.citeAs: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu. Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv preprint arXiv:2510.20888v1, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by collecting 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet spanning diverse subjects (men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, multi-subject cases), then using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs to generate paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images collected from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. Paired videos were generated using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Reference images were matched to compatible visual-effects templates from commercial models and community LoRAs to generate paired videos. Some templates restrict subject categories, so not all images were matched to all templates.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos were resized to 480×720(832) resolution and sampled at 49 frames at 16fps for training.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Standard video-description captions were used to describe the reference and target videos, matching the pre-training data distribution. Captions describe the semantic attributes shared between reference and target videos.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial Image-to-Video models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs were used to generate paired videos from reference images. Gemini-2.5-pro and GPT-5 were used for automatic semantic alignment scoring during evaluation.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes images and videos of men, women, children, and diverse subjects. Gender-related semantic conditions include 'gender swap'.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, 'deepfake' content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. The dataset is intended for research, education, and creative prototyping only, not for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models (commercial models and community LoRAs), which may cause VAP to inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates. For example, if source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates. Performance depends on caption quality and structural similarity between main subjects: it is stable when caption styles align and subjects are similar, but degrades when descriptions diverge or when subjects differ markedly. Building a large, real-world, semantic-controlled video dataset would help address these issues but is beyond the paper's main focus.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of unified semantic-controlled video generation models. The dataset supports diverse semantic control tasks including concept-guided generation (entity transformation and interaction), style-guided generation, motion-guided generation (human and non-human motion transfer), and camera-guided generation. For evaluation, 24 semantic conditions were evenly sampled from 4 categories with 2 samples each, totaling 48 test samples.

name.evidence: We introduce VAP-Data, the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation, with over 100K curated samples across 100 semantic conditions, providing a robust data foundation for unified semantic-controlled video generation.

We then use Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates... Overall, we obtain VAP-Data, a semantic-controlled paired dataset with over 100K samples across 100 semantic conditions—the largest resource.
